To Whom It May Concern,  

Theo van den Berg 94 has been a consistent contributor to NexaGame Studios’ AI initiatives as our Senior ML Engineer. As a direct manager, I’ve observed his ability to translate complex game dynamics into scalable machine learning solutions, balancing technical rigor with creative collaboration.  

Theo’s expertise in NLP and recommendation systems has been central to our product’s success. He designed a player behavior analysis module using PyTorch that improved engagement metrics by 30% across three major titles. His work on contextual recommendation systems, leveraging TensorFlow and GCP, reduced user churn by 15% in Q3 2023. These systems now handle over 20 million interactions monthly, with deployment pipelines managed via Docker and AWS.  

A standout example occurred when Theo led a redesign of our enemy AI behavior model. By integrating computer vision techniques with reinforcement learning, he increased adaptive difficulty accuracy by 25% while reducing computational overhead by 40%. This required cross-team coordination and rigorous testing, which he executed with meticulous attention to detail.  

Theo’s work ethic is marked by reliability and intellectual curiosity. He mentors junior engineers on best practices in model deployment and MLOps, often sharing insights from his own experiments with MLflow andWeights & Biases. His ability to distill technical challenges into actionable strategies has been invaluable to our small team’s growth.  

In summary, Theo’s technical depth, strategic thinking, and collaborative spirit make him a critical asset. I recommend him without reservation for any role requiring innovation at scale.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
Direct Manager, NexaGame Studios
